{"action":"shell","command":"cd /testbed && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
p="specs/001-transactions/checklists/requirements.md"
s=open(p).read()
old="- Items marked incomplete would require spec updates before\n  `$speckit-plan`; none are incomplete. One carried-forward open item:\n  Claim-A candidate extension (put recency refresh on overwrite) to be\n  resolved in clarify/plan."
new=("- Items marked incomplete would require spec updates before\n"
"  `$speckit-plan`; none are incomplete. Carried-forward open items: (1) Claim-A\n"
"  candidate extension (put recency refresh on overwrite) to be resolved in\n"
"  clarify/plan; (2) Claim-A round-2 resize expiry clarification (R07/R08\n"
"  referenced but not yet defined) - recorded as assumption, revisit if a\n"
"  TTL/expiry milestone lands.\n"
"- Milestone 2 validation run 2026-10-17: spec.md updated to retain R01-R03 and\n"
"  add R04 (invalidate_many any/all; empty requested tags remove zero in either\n"
"  mode; invalid mode/tags rejected before mutation; invalidate compatibility),\n"
"  R05 (resize validates positive non-bool int first; survivors keep LRU order;\n"
"  shrink evicts LRU; grow evicts nothing; failed resize preserves all state;\n"
"  maxsize property reports current capacity), R06 (generator tags consumed\n"
"  once; detached returns incl. nested lists/dicts). Added user stories 4-5,\n"
"  FR-014..FR-019, SC-006, and 8 new edge cases. Superseded design-note prose\n"
"  (empty all matches every key; resize may flush) explicitly overridden per\n"
"  R04/R05. `grep -c 'NEEDS CLARIFICATION' spec.md` -> 0. All 16 items [x].")
assert old in s, "anchor not found"
s=s.replace(old,new,1)
open(p,"w").write(s)
print("checklist updated OK")
PYEOF"}
